sentences.text:
This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER 1. Heard.
Perused the case diary.
2. This is first application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. filed by the applicant for grant of bail.

The applicant has been implicated in connection with Crime No.390/2022, registered at Police Station " Nanakheda, District - Ujjain, (M.P.), for offences punishable under Sections 366, 376(2)(a), 342 of the IPC and Section 5L/6 of the POCSO Act.
The applicant is in custody since 03.06.2023.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the alleged offence.
She is not involved in crime of rape and nothing has been stated in Radhabai vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/98568401/

sentences.text: 1 the statement of prosecutrix recorded under Section 161 of the Cr.P.C.

Her name has been added only in the statement of prosecutrix recorded under Section 164 of the Cr.P.C. which has been recorded on 19.09.2022, after six months of statement of the prosecutrix recorded under Section 161 of the Cr.P.C.
The name of the applicant has not been mentioned in the FIR and the FIR is belated by two days.
The applicant is in jail since 03.06.2023.
Charge-sheet has been filed.
Conclusion of trial will take considerable long time.
Under such circumstances, he prays for grant of bail.

4. On the other hand, learned Panel Lawyer for the non-applicant/State opposed the prayer and prays for rejection of the bail application.
5.

Having gone through the record and the case diary and looking to the fact that applicant is a young lady aged 30 years and her name has not been mentioned in the FIR and she is in custody since 03.06.2023, without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, this application is allowed.

6. It is directed that the applicant be released on bail on her furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for securing her presence before the said Court on all the dates of hearing fixed in this regard during trial.

It is also directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 437(3) Cr.P.C.
7.

This order shall remain effective till the end of the trial, but in case of bail jump and breach of any of the pre-condition of bail, it shall become ineffective and cancelled without reference to this Bench.
8. The M.Cr.C. stands allowed and disposed of.
